description: Read your provider check results as they arrive: one row per NPI with a verdict (needs_attention: a problem; checking: not settled yet and not counted as a problem; records_to_fix: records to tidy; clean: none of these), short findings, every cell with its source link and read time (a license still queued has none yet), and the mismatches between records. While the check runs, next says what is being read, why it is not done yet and when to look again (look_again_in_seconds), and estimated_seconds grows when the check is late. Use the request ID and the email that sent the list.
name: provider_check_status
title: Read provider check results
